solutions.headline2: And the solutions built on it
solutions.body: AlpOS is the constant. Cybersecurity and Digital Transformation are how it's applied, same sovereignty, same audit, same spine.
solutions.alposBody: The sovereign AI platform underneath every Davion solution. Ingest, ontology, analytics, AI, decisioning, action, governed end to end.
solutions.cyberBody: Defensive intelligence for environments that cannot fail. Detection through pattern, anomaly, and graph analysis, inside your perimeter.
solutions.digitalBody: From siloed data to a single governed source of truth, phased from POC to industrial deployment, without losing the institution.

alposTeaser.headline: The sovereign AI platform underneath every Davion solution
alposTeaser.body: AlpOS unifies data, ontology, analytics, and agentic AI in one modular platform, ingest to act, governed end to end. Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, and OSINT are how it is applied.

cycle.body: Every Davion deployment runs the same sovereign cycle, from raw data to operational action. The platform stays constant; the surface adapts to the use case.

01.title: Ingest
01.body: Pull every relevant signal through a single governed pipeline.

02.title: Model
02.body: Shape it as entities, events, and relationships in your ontology.

03.title: Reason
03.body: Run AI against the ontology with citations back to source.

04.title: Act
04.body: Embed the decision into operators and systems of record.
